title: Applicationinteraction depends-on Applicationevent
description: The interaction requires a specific state-change occurrence to start, advance or complete, such as a choreography step that waits for a PaymentCaptured event before continuing.
x-dr-evidence: Participant code subscribes to the event's topic or queue (e.g. a Kafka listener or event handler registration) as a step of the saga, or the saga definition names the event as a trigger or transition.
